jobs.title: Associate Vice President, Finance Business Process & Systems Lead
jobs.description:
Position Summary
The Associate Vice President serves as the senior techno-functional leader for the firm’s core finance operations spanning Accounting, Accounts Receivable, Billing, and Payroll, together with the reporting and data integrity that underpin them. Sitting at the intersection of finance and technology within the Finance Process & Operations (FPO) team, the role owns the process and systems landscape for these functions and sets the strategy for how AI, automation, and emerging technology create value across them.

As the AI and technology champion for these functions, the AVP defines where automation and AI deliver the highest return, maintains a prioritized portfolio of use cases, and establishes the governance needed to adopt new technology safely. The role pairs this forward-looking mandate with deep accountability for data integrity and controls - ensuring accuracy, auditability, and compliance across record-to-report and order-to-cash processes.

The AVP is a trusted strategic partner to finance leadership, translating business goals into a technology and process roadmap and representing these functions in firmwide initiatives. The role leads a team of FPO staff and consultants through agile delivery, manages risk and exposure across the domain, and communicates progress and trade-offs to senior leadership. Success requires the judgment to balance strategic transformation with the day-to-day realities of finance operations, and the influence to drive outcomes across a broad set of stakeholders.

In-Office Requirement: 4 days a week

Primary Responsibilities
AI/Technology Champion & Strategic Partnership (~25%)
- Serve as the AI and technology champion for the GL, AR, Billing, and Payroll functions, setting the vision for where AI and automation create the most value and driving adoption across the teams
- Maintain a prioritized portfolio of AI and automation use cases, applying a value-to-effort lens to sequence investment toward the highest-return initiatives
- Establish lightweight governance for AI use in finance - covering data usage, access, model validation, and human oversight - in partnership with GTS and risk functions
- Act as a trusted strategic partner to finance leadership, translating business goals into a technology and process roadmap for the domain and surfacing risks, opportunities, and trade-offs
- Serve as the senior business owner and SME representing these functions in cross-functional and firmwide initiatives, influencing priorities and resourcing without direct authority over all stakeholders
- Stay current on emerging AI, low-code/no-code, and finance-technology trends, evaluating their fit and redesigning roles and processes around AI capability as routine work is automated

Process Ownership & Data Integrity (~20%)
- Own the end-to-end record-to-report and order-to-cash process landscape across GL, AR, Billing, and Payroll, and the systems that support them
- Champion data integrity across these functions, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and consistency of financial data and standard data definitions with clear ownership
- Oversee the control framework for the domain, including GL and subledger reconciliations and SOX process and control documentation, partnering with audit
- Drive standardization and modernization of core workflows - billing and receivables, payroll accounting, journal entry, and reconciliations - to compress close timelines and reduce manual error
- Ensure system changes preserve controls, auditability, and compliance with GAAP and SOX across the domain

Project & Delivery Execution (~20%)
- Lead delivery of technology and process initiatives across the domain, from discovery and fit-gap through design, build, UAT, deployment, and stabilization
- Own the initiative roadmap and backlog, balancing strategic programs against day-to-day enhancement demand
- Drive fit-gap analyses, future-state process design, system integrations, and data migration for finance-systems initiatives
- Coordinate closely with GTS on build, QA, and technical delivery, serving as the bridge between business vision and technical execution
- Manage initiative scope, dependencies, and timelines, holding delivery to quality standards and deadlines

Team Oversight & Agile Leadership (~20%)
- Lead and develop a team spanning FPO staff and consultants, providing direction, coaching, and timely performance feedback
- Run the domain’s agile delivery - backlog refinement, sprint planning, and prioritization - and foster an agile, continuous-improvement mindset
- Set standards for service delivery, quality control, and support across the team
- Manage vendor and consultant relationships, scaling resourcing to the initiative portfolio
- Allocate people and resources across multiple concurrent projects to deliver high-quality outcomes on time

Risk Mitigation & Communication (~15%)
- Anticipate, identify, and mitigate delivery, operational, and control risks across the domain, escalating with recommended course corrections
- Manage risk and exposure appropriate to the funds, entities, and processes the domain touches, and ensure business continuity for critical operations through production support triage and resolution
- Apply firmwide compliance standards across all work and escalate issues to the appropriate point of contact
- Communicate initiative status, risks, and outcomes to finance and technology leadership, tailoring messaging to executive audiences
- Prepare and present steering-committee and leadership materials, including metrics on volume, exceptions, and delivery progress, presenting complex topics in a straightforward and concise way

Requirements
Education & Certificates
- Bachelor’s degree required
- Concentration in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Information Systems, or a related field, preferred

Professional Experience
- 7+ years of overall relevant experience, required
- Experience in finance/accounting operations, financial systems, and process improvement, with significant experience across GL, AR, Billing, and/or Payroll, preferred
- Proven experience as a business/technology lead bridging finance and GTS or development teams
- Track record leading process reengineering and finance-systems implementations across ERP and related platforms
- Demonstrated experience applying AI and automation to finance processes, with the ability to set strategy and governance, not just use the tools
- Experience with system governance, controls, change management, master data management, and data quality
- People leadership experience - managing direct reports and/or consultants - required
- Familiarity with agile delivery and tools such as Jira; Six Sigma or Lean a plus
- Background in private equity, financial services, or alternative investment operations preferred

Competencies & Attributes
- Proficiency with generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Microsoft Copilot, and a track record of applying AI to finance workflows at a strategic level
- Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial close, and data integrity and SOX controls
- Financial systems experience required across ERP and related platforms such as PeopleSoft Financials; BI and reporting tools a plus, SQL a plus
- Experience owning record-to-report and order-to-cash processes across GL, AR, Billing, and Payroll
- Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across functions, seniority levels, and the broader firm
- Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to tailor messaging across finance, technology, and senior leadership audiences
- Advanced Excel and PowerPoint; strong presentation skills
- Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills with an inquisitive, forward-thinking mindset
- Demonstrated ability to lead and develop both direct reports and indirect or consultant team members
- Highly organized with strong attention to detail, able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

Benefits/Compensation
The compensation range for this role is specific to Washington, DC and takes into account a wide range of factors including but not limited to the skill sets required/preferred; prior experience and training; licenses and/or certifications.

The anticipated base salary range for this role is $150,000 to $170,000.

In addition to the base salary, the hired professional will enjoy a comprehensive benefits package spanning retirement benefits, health insurance, life insurance and disability, paid time off, paid holidays, family planning benefits and various wellness programs. jobs.title: Principal/Managing Director
jobs.description:
Position Summary – Global Portfolio Solutions (GPS) – Asia CIO
We are seeking an exceptional technology leader to join the Global Portfolio Solutions (GPS) – Asia team, working directly with the Asia Head of Global Portfolio Solutions. This individual will serve as Carlyle’s primary technology value creation resource for Asia, partnering with portfolio management teams, deal teams, and GPS functional peers to accelerate technology-driven value creation across Carlyle’s Asia Buyout portfolio.

The GPS Asia CIO role will be the connective tissue between Carlyle’s investment professionals and the technology leadership at our portfolio companies – translating strategic investment theses into concrete technology execution roadmaps, and converting lessons learned across the portfolio into scalable playbooks, partnerships, and community. This person will be a member of a lean, but highly-capable, GPS Asia team and will work collaboratively with other Global GPS functional leaders.

Above all, this person will serve as a trusted, technology expert to deal teams and portfolio company technology leaders alike – leveraging deep technical and operational expertise, strong listening skills, and a practitioner’s credibility to drive outsized technology value creation across the portfolio.

Primary Responsibilities
Value Creation & Portfolio Engagement
- Partner directly with portfolio management teams, deal teams, and GPS functional peers to develop and execute technology value creation roadmaps aligned to each company’s investment thesis and stage of ownership
- Advise portfolio companies on how to architect and execute large-scale technology transformation programs, including carve-outs, acquisitions, modernization, platform consolidation, and cloud migration initiatives
- Evaluate portfolio companies’ technology spend, identifying opportunities to optimize across labor, software, hardware and services that can drive meaningful impact on profitability
- Advise portfolio companies on optimizing their technology operating models, including decisions around onshore/offshore organizational structures, build vs. buy vs. partner tradeoffs, and vendor management
- Build and maintain a network of high-performing technology leaders that can fill permanent or temporary vacant roles at portfolio companies
- Serve as a thought partner to portfolio company CIOs, CTOs, and CPOs on strategic technology investment prioritization, product engineering capacity, and organizational design

Knowledge Creation & Dissemination
- Develop and curate technology-focused case studies and playbooks that capture best practices in technology execution, transformation, and investment across the Carlyle portfolio
- Maintain a living body of GPS technology knowledge, including frameworks, assessments, and reference architectures, made accessible to deal teams and portfolio companies through the GPS resource portal
- Partner with GPS peers across functional areas (commercial excellence, pricing, digital/AI, cost optimization) to integrate technology perspectives into cross-functional value creation initiatives

Community & Events
- Lead the design and execution of Carlyle’s annual technology leadership summits, convening C-level Technology, Product, and Engineering leaders from across the portfolio to share best practices, benchmark performance, and forge peer relationships
- Convene periodic community webinars and forums for portfolio company technology leaders to exchange insights on common challenges, emerging technologies, and vendor experiences
- Build and sustain a trusted peer-to-peer network among portfolio company technology executives, acting as a connector and convener across the community

Strategic Partnerships
- Identify, evaluate, and foster strategic partnerships with technology product and service providers – including software vendors, systems integrators, cloud providers, and managed services firms – that can deliver value at scale across the portfolio
- Develop and manage a curated network of technology consultants, contractors, and implementation partners that GPS and portfolio companies can engage for high-priority initiatives
- Evaluate and pilot emerging technology solutions, including AI/ML platforms, automation tooling, and data infrastructure, for applicability across the Carlyle portfolio in Asia

Deal Support
- Partner with deal teams to provide technology expert opinion, diligence support, and risk assessment on prospective investments, with particular focus on technology architecture, product roadmap maturity, platform scalability, engineering team capability, and technical debt
- Contribute to investment committee materials and value creation planning for new platform and add-on investments

Requirements
The candidate will be a highly-accomplished technology executive or senior practitioner, likely having served as a CTO, CIO or equivalent at a PE- or venture-backed company that has successfully executed a meaningful technology transformation, or as a senior leader within a top-tier technology consulting or advisory firm. In addition to 10 - 15 years of overall professional experience, they will have:

- Deep expertise across the technology value creation landscape, including product engineering, software architecture, infrastructure modernization, digital transformation, and AI/ML adoption
- Demonstrated ability to lead or oversee large, complex technology transformation programs in environments with competing priorities and significant organizational change
- Experience advising on or executing technology operating model design, including onshore/offshore hybrid models, platform team structures, and vendor management frameworks
- A track record of translating strategic technology investments into measurable business outcomes – revenue growth, cost reduction, margin expansion, or enterprise value creation
- Familiarity with the private equity deal cycle, value creation planning, and the expectations of PE-backed company management teams
- Experience with cyber breaches/incidents, and how to advise crafting a response
- Ability to engage credibly and influence at the CTO, CIO, CPO, CFO, COO and CEO level, as well as with PE investment professionals
- Experience building and leveraging ecosystems of technology partners, vendors, and advisors to accelerate execution
- A passion for knowledge sharing, community building, and developing others – not just solving problems individually
- Strong ability to help portfolio companies enhance performance through consultation and collaboration, rather than applying rigid, one-size-fits-all prescriptions

Background Requirements (for everyone in GPS)
- A track record of outstanding achievement and increasing levels of responsibility
- Familiarity with private equity, the deal process, and the stakeholders within an alternative asset manager and a private equity business
- An entrepreneurial and creative approach to leverage new developments and innovative ideas to continuously improve the business operations of a portfolio operations business
- Ability to balance multiple stakeholders while working collaboratively – with discretion and without ego – to drive results
- Strong analytical capacity and intellectual horsepower to understand and use data and information
- Fluency in creating and optimizing lean, agile systems – including technology tools – to get things done; someone who brings others along in their adoption and utilization
- Self-starter with tremendous amounts of individual initiative; a forward-thinking, planful person who humbly brings the team along toward eventually generating operational excellence across the organization
- Exceptional ability at architecting and influencing portfolio management teams in the planning, managing, and delivering projects in a proactive fashion: intuitively “picks up and owns” challenges and opportunities across the business
- Strong self-discipline to stay on task while navigating complex bureaucracies with cross-cutting interests, coupled with extreme agility to re-prioritize as needed and when unexpected situations arise
- The poise, aplomb, and discretion to interact, influence, and rapidly earn trust across both GPS and the firm, both top to bottom and across each organization
- Superior written and verbal communications skills
- Embodiment of Carlyle’s core values: values-driven leader of unquestioned integrity, a strong work ethic, a commitment to no-ego teamwork, and a no-excuses mindset around excellence
- Asia project experience is an advantage of not a must;  and willing to relocate to Asia and  grow the career in Asia.

jobs.description:
Carlyle AlpInvest Overview

Carlyle AlpInvest is one of the largest private markets investors globally with over $102 billion AUM and more than 120 investment professionals. With offices in New York, London, Amsterdam, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Tokyo, Carlyle AlpInvest is a core division of the Carlyle Group.

Carlyle AlpInvest operates three closely integrated investment strategies: (i) Primary Fund Investments platform commits capital to new private equity and private credit funds, (ii) Co-Investments platform provides capital for direct investments alongside our relationship sponsors, and (iii) Secondary & Portfolio Finance platform provides liquidity solutions through a broad range of secondary and financing transactions.

Platform Overview

Carlyle AlpInvest’s Secondary and Portfolio Finance team spans the globe and boasts decades of investment expertise and experience through market cycles. Having committed over $45 billion across more than 250 Secondary and Portfolio Finance investments over the last 25 years, we have significant experience in partnering with owners and managers of private equity and private credit funds across a broad range of liquidity solutions. Our collaborative approach leverages our Primary Fund Investments and Co-Investments capabilities to deliver sourcing and information advantages from a universe of nearly 400 relationship sponsors globally, supporting our strategic relationship angle across the Secondary and Portfolio Finance markets.

Carlyle AlpInvest is currently investing its $20 billion AlpInvest Secondary Program VIII and manages one of the largest dedicated Portfolio Finance funds, having raised $3.2 billion for AlpInvest Strategic Portfolio Finance Program II at its hard cap in Q2 2025.
